title: Type VideoJob — production job; VideoML renders; Babulus owns the job
description:
Parked type spec — do not implement. Not in progress. File stays on Babulus (not a VideoML code change).

## Type: VideoJob

Production of an Asset (Video deliverable) or Slot creative. Chattic bots claim by state. **VideoML renders; Babulus owns the job.** VideoML is the renderer, not the publicity calendar.

## States

`brief` → `script` → `render` → `preview` → `approved` → `published` | `killed`

Ryan approval applies before anything is queued or posted from the resulting asset.

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> brief
  brief --> script
  script --> render
  render --> preview
  preview --> approved
  approved --> published
  approved --> killed
  preview --> killed
  published --> [*]
  killed --> [*]
```

## Out of scope

- No VideoML calendar
- No auto-publish to social
- No implementation from this issue
